tool_usage.name: LaZagne
tool_usage.description: [LaZagne](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0349) is a post-exploitation, open-source tool used to recover stored passwords on a system. It has modules for Windows, Linux, and OSX, but is mainly focused on Windows systems. [LaZagne](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0349) is publicly available on GitHub.(Citation: GitHub LaZagne Dec 2018)

claim_assessments.statement: Leafminer uses or has used LaZagne.

tool_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

tool_usage.name: MailSniper
tool_usage.description: MailSniper is a penetration testing tool for searching through email in a Microsoft Exchange environment for specific terms (passwords, insider intel, network architecture information, etc.). It can be used by a non-administrative user to search their own email, or by an Exchange administrator to search the mailboxes of every user in a domain.(Citation: GitHub MailSniper)

claim_assessments.statement: Leafminer uses or has used MailSniper.

tool_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

tool_usage.name: Mimikatz
tool_usage.description: [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) is a credential dumper capable of obtaining plaintext Windows account logins and passwords, along with many other features that make it useful for testing the security of networks. (Citation: Deply Mimikatz) (Citation: Adsecurity Mimikatz Guide)

claim_assessments.statement: Leafminer uses or has used Mimikatz.

tool_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted

tool_usage.name: PsExec
tool_usage.description: [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) is a free Microsoft tool that can be used to execute a program on another computer. It is used by IT administrators and attackers.(Citation: Russinovich Sysinternals)(Citation: SANS PsExec)

claim_assessments.statement: Leafminer uses or has used PsExec.

tool_usage.temporal_assessment: actor-level-only; no campaign-specific use date is asserted
